# MDD Sim Gateway v1.9.5

## 中文

### 0. 重要更新说明

- **本版本只有一条修复，只改动 WebUI 的浏览器软电话。**没有麦克风的电脑现在也能拨号和接听，
  界面会明确说明这类通话是「仅收听」。
- **本版本没有改动 Engine。**只需更新 Control（WebUI 打包在 Control 镜像内）；手动升级可用
  `sudo ./install.sh reload --no-engines`，不需要重建引擎镜像。
- **本版本暂不开放自动安装。**自动更新通道仍保持在 v1.9.1，v1.9.2 起的各版本都需要手动升级。
  待实机验证确认后再开放。

### 1. v1.9.5 本次小版本更新

**WebUI**

- **在没有麦克风的电脑上，点击拨号后通话立刻断开，界面只显示「通话结束」。** WebRTC 拨号的
  第一步是向浏览器索取麦克风，拿不到设备时会话在点击后约 10 毫秒就结束，连 INVITE 都没发出去；
  而 JsSIP 把所有媒体失败都归为同一个笼统原因，界面又把它显示成「通话结束」，看起来像是运营商
  拒接，实际问题根本没离开过浏览器。WebRTC 需要的是一条本地音频轨，而不是麦克风：现在拿不到
  麦克风时改用静音轨发起通话，对方的声音照常能听到——查语音信箱、听运营商语音提示、拨服务码
  这些场景本来就不需要说话。空闲时拨号面板会提示，呼叫中和通话中全程显示「仅收听 · 对方听不到
  你的声音」，静音按钮在静音轨上置灰，接听来电走同一条路径。另外拨号按钮现在会读它自己显示的
  注册状态，不再往一个没连上的 websocket 里发 INVITE。
  （[#90](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/90)）

### 2. v1.9 功能概览

- 线路可自定义向运营商标识的 SIP User-Agent，默认仍为 `MDD-Sim-Gateway`。
- SIM 访问支持 APDU-level 响应的读卡器与 T=1 卡，覆盖 SELECT 与 READ 全流程。
- 国家出口选择器可按中英文国家名与两位国家代码搜索，并支持键盘选择。
- 重命名运行中的 SIM 线路不再重建 IKE 与 Asterisk 引擎；改动运行参数仍会重启线路以生效。
- 手动更新可在最近五个正式版本中选择，便于回退或切换版本。
- 换出口的判定只在隧道于网络层得不到应答时归咎于出口；运营商侧的授权拒绝不再换节点
  （v1.9.2 起）。

本版本只改动 WebUI。Engine 源码没有变化，升级时无需重建引擎镜像。

## English

### 0. Important notes

- **This release carries one fix and touches only the WebUI softphone.** A computer with no
  microphone can now place and answer calls, and the interface says plainly that such a call
  is listen-only.
- **The engine did not change.** Only Control needs updating (the WebUI ships inside the
  Control image); a manual upgrade can run `sudo ./install.sh reload --no-engines` and does
  not need an engine rebuild.
- **Automatic installation stays closed.** The auto-update channels remain on v1.9.1, so every
  release from v1.9.2 on must be installed manually. The channels move once this is confirmed
  on real hardware.

### 1. Changed in v1.9.5

**WebUI**

- **On a computer with no microphone, a call ended the instant it was dialled and the screen
  said only "Call ended".** WebRTC's first step is asking the browser for a microphone, so
  with no device the session ended about ten milliseconds after the click without an INVITE
  ever being sent; JsSIP reports every media failure as one generic cause, which the screen
  rendered as "Call ended" — it read as a carrier rejection for a problem that never left the
  browser. WebRTC needs a local audio track, not a microphone: the call is now placed on a
  silent one, so the other side is still heard, which is the whole point of dialling a
  voicemail box, an announcement or a service code. The dialler says so while idle, the
  ringing and connected screens carry "Listen only · the other side cannot hear you" for the
  whole call, Mute is disabled on a track that is already silent, and answering an incoming
  call takes the same path. The Call button also reads the registration state it already
  displays, instead of sending an INVITE into a websocket that is not connected
  ([#90](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/90)).

### 2. v1.9 feature overview

- A line can present its own SIP User-Agent to the carrier; the default remains
  `MDD-Sim-Gateway`.
- SIM access supports APDU-level readers and T=1 cards across SELECT and READ.
- The country exit picker searches by English and Chinese country names and two-letter codes,
  with keyboard selection.
- Renaming a running SIM line no longer rebuilds the IKE and Asterisk engines; changing runtime
  parameters still restarts the line so they take effect.
- Manual updates can select any of the last five official releases, for rollback or switching.
- Exit attribution blames the node only for a tunnel that went unanswered on the network;
  carrier-side authorization refusals no longer move the node (since v1.9.2).

This release changes the WebUI only. The engine sources are unchanged, so no engine image
rebuild is required to upgrade.
